# Test fixtures

- `lookups.json`: the words the lookup tests check, and the result expected for each.
- `mini-dict.jsonl`: the lines of the full dictionary that those lookups read, in the format `src/scripts/build-dict.js` writes. Generated by `tests/make-fixture.js`; do not edit by hand.
- `kaikki-sample.jsonl`: a few hand-written entries in the raw format of kaikki.org, used to test the build script. Their built form also replaces the same words in `mini-dict.jsonl`, so the cases for words with several readings do not depend on which dictionary build the fixture was generated from.

The dictionary lines come from the English Wiktionary by way of kaikki.org and are available under CC BY-SA, like the dictionary the extension imports.
